name: Three-step instruction, hard cut per line
looks: Under a small eyebrow label, three short imperative lines land one per hard cut: two in plain black, the third's last word in bold accent colour, a cursor idling beside it. A thin HUD frame with corner marks and a running label sits around the whole shot.
build: kinetic-word-run adapted to full lines instead of single words: each line is its own hard cut, no crossfade, the third line's final word getting its own colour and weight; hud-frame's corner brackets and label run underneath for the whole scene.
sound: A hit on each line's cut, heavier on the third.
prompt: State what the product does as three short imperative steps, hard-cutting from one line to the next with no crossfade, the last line's key word landing in the brand's accent colour as the payoff, inside a thin technical frame that signals a developer tool.
